QuestionStmt.S: If the points $A(1, 1, 2)$, $B(2, 1, p)$, $C(1, 0, 3)$ and $D(2, 2, 0)$ are coplanar then the value of $p$ is

Solution.S:
$\overrightarrow{AB} = \hat{i} + (p-2)\hat{k}$.

$\overrightarrow{AC} = -\hat{j} + \hat{k}$.

$\overrightarrow{AD} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}$.

For coplanar points, $[\overrightarrow{AB}\ \overrightarrow{AC}\ \overrightarrow{AD}] = 0$.

$$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & p-2 \\ 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = 0$$

$1(2-1) - 0 + (p-2)(1) = 1 + p - 2 = p - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow p = 1$.

Thus the correct option is C: 1.
